cohort: 100 anemic pregnant women between 32 and 40 weeks of gestation (hemoglobin between 7 and 10.9 g%) admitted to the labor room at Lady Hardinge Medical College and Associated Hospitals, New Delhi.
finding: Delayed cord clamping (DCC) did not increase mean blood loss or third-stage complications compared to early cord clamping (ECC) in anemic pregnant women.
